install: set -euo pipefail; touch "$HOME/.bashrc"; sed -i '/case \$- in/,/esac/d' "$HOME/.bashrc" 2>/dev/null || true; for line in 'export PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1' 'export PYTHONUTF8=1' 'export PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8' 'export CODEX_UPSTREAM="$HOME/upstream"'; do grep -qxF "$line" "$HOME/.bashrc" || echo "$line" >> "$HOME/.bashrc"; done; export PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONUTF8=1 PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8 CODEX_UPSTREAM="$HOME/upstream"; TAG="$(gh api repos/openai/codex/releases/latest --jq .tag_name 2>/dev/null || true)"; if [ -z "$TAG" ]; then TAG="$(git ls-remote --tags --refs https://github.com/openai/codex.git 'refs/tags/rust-v*' | awk -F/ '{print $NF}' | grep -E '^rust-v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$' | sort -V | tail -n 1)"; fi; if [ ! -d "$CODEX_UPSTREAM/.git" ]; then rm -rf "$CODEX_UPSTREAM" && git clone --depth 1 --branch "$TAG" https://github.com/openai/codex.git "$CODEX_UPSTREAM"; elif [ "$(git -C "$CODEX_UPSTREAM" describe --tags --exact-match 2>/dev/null || true)" != "$TAG" ]; then git -C "$CODEX_UPSTREAM" fetch --depth 1 origin "refs/tags/$TAG:refs/tags/$TAG" && git -C "$CODEX_UPSTREAM" checkout -f "$TAG"; else git -C "$CODEX_UPSTREAM" checkout -- .; fi; if command -v rustup >/dev/null 2>&1 && [ -d "$CODEX_UPSTREAM/codex-rs" ]; then (cd "$CODEX_UPSTREAM/codex-rs" && rustup toolchain install --no-self-update); fi; for f in i18n/zh-CN/*.json; do python3 -m json.tool "$f" >/dev/null; done
